name: The Living Universe
oneLiner: Ken's photograph stands as a lit window at "now", the centre of a universe made only of his work; the newest video is the newest light, and everything older recedes outward into the past.
signature: One universe, three ways in: select a light to read it, follow a documented thread to related work, replay the growth of the whole record over time. Conventional navigation, list view and search sit beside it, so nobody needs the universe to find content.
type: Instrument Serif (display, headings, tagline) · Hanken Grotesk (text, UI, universe labels) · JetBrains Mono (hashes in receipts only). No text under 14px.
